zh: 这条式子已经说明标量 \(C\) 为什么不闭合。粘性部分除了 \(-\nu|h|^2C(h)\)，还需要带绝对频率权重的梯度相关；非线性部分还 需要 \(u(w+2p)\)。即使给定 \(p\)，\(C\) 也不能恢复其中带符号的 速度因子；同时 \(p=R_iR_j(u_i u_j)\) 的一般重建另需完整张量，而 \(C=\widehat{|u|^2}\) 只记录其迹。
en: This formula already shows why the scalar \(C\) does not close. Besides \(-\nu|h|^2C(h)\), the viscous part requires a gradient correlation weighted by absolute frequency; the nonlinear part also requires \(u(w+2p)\). Even with \(p\) given, \(C\) cannot recover the signed velocity factor in that flux. At the same time, general reconstruction through \(p=R_iR_j(u_i u_j)\) separately requires the full tensor, whereas \(C=\widehat{|u|^2}\) records only its trace.

zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73T 的全部 136 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。 我把 R0.73R 的当前价值评为“可靠的桥接引理与反例工具”，而不是高水平正则性主定理。可保留之处是：分层拆开能量、加法几何与高阶相位；给出有限 Fourier 数据可复算的严格证书；用同谱确定性族证明二次能谱不足。 本节真正完成的是三件较窄但可用的工作。 限定式碰撞检索没有发现与“标量能量密度自相关 \(A Q\) + 两个精确非自治见证”完全相同的打包，但有限检索不是新颖性或优先权证明。本站只把它称为可审计的本地综合。
en: This page retains all 136 nodes from R0.61 through R0.73T. R0.61–R0.69W progresses from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, the critical ledger, internal entry, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I successively treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, fixed-right-half-plane transfer, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, planar fixed-distance deviation, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies the inviscid continuous-spectrum branch, R0.73K closes the parameter-uniform viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuine non-autonomous selected action; R0.73M then specifies the seed by the complete action and closes a two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance deviation at a fixed physical time. The background varies with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit remains in an exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; the prefactor limit, two-term WKB expansion, fixed background, transverse three-dimensional dynamics, singularity, and Clay are not extrapolated. R0.73M proves that when \(\Lambda\to\infty\) and the background changes accordingly, a planar perturbation reduced according to the full action can retain an order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution obeys finite cumulative-strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie in a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Consequently, the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on one fixed background. R0.73O closes the instability route based on \(H^3\)-small perturbations of a known unforced global background: every orbit eventually decays, the cumulative \(H^4\) action is finite, and a positive stability radius works for every starting time. The forced comparison retains infinite cumulative strain and provides a globally smooth planar witness whose initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero while its output has fixed \(L^2\) escape. R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube works for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent for norm transfer is exact, and smooth perturbations may have vanishing \(L^2\) norm while their \(H^3\) norm diverges. Every weak branch in the energy ball becomes regular after a common delay and synchronizes with the reference orbit; the part that cannot be crossed is the earlier weak interval. This section uses a periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recurrence to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it includes smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness belongs to the known literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open. I assess the current value of R0.73R as “a reliable bridge lemma and counterexample tool,” not as a high-level regularity theorem. The retained contributions are the separation of energy, additive geometry, and higher-order phase; rigorous certificates reproducible from finite Fourier data; and an isospectral deterministic family proving that the quadratic energy spectrum is insufficient. This section actually completes three narrower but usable tasks. A targeted collision search found no packaging identical to “scalar energy-density autocorrelation \(A Q\) + two exact non-autonomy witnesses,” but a finite search is not proof of novelty or priority. This site describes it only as an auditable local synthesis.

en: Neither 136 nodes nor 98 public releases can be interpreted as a percentage of Clay completion. The one-sided dynamic estimate holds, but the critical A integral, signed flux, and tensor heat closure remain open. Global regularity for arbitrary three-dimensional initial data remains OPEN.
